description.value: Bistro Taiyo is a 100% authentic Japanese-owned sushi bar and izakaya that has been operating in Nanaimo's historic Old City Quarter since 2001. The restaurant is celebrated for handcrafted specialty rolls, in-house ramen, fresh seafood, and traditional izakaya fare paired with an extensive sake and Japanese beer selection. The name 'Taiyo' means 'Sun' in Japanese, reflecting the founders' philosophy of being a welcoming presence for all who visit.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: ground_slots (4 spaces) at 77m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bistrotaiyo.com was successfully fetched and is actively maintained (last updated November 25, 2025), confirming the business is open. The phone number 250-716-8861 on the website matches the OSM tag. Takeout is confirmed via a dedicated navigation section and menu; vegan options are explicitly advertised with multiple vegan ramen dishes listed. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website footer shows '© Bistro Taiyo 2023' but the site was clearly updated in November 2025 — outdated copyright year only, not a closure signal.
Website includes legacy COVID-19 safety protocol language that has not been removed, suggesting some content sections are not regularly pruned.
Street address (321 Wesley Street, Unit 2) is not explicitly stated on the website; OSM address used by default and could not be confirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating Japanese restaurant in downtown Nanaimo with a well-maintained website updated November 2025. A clear inclusion for the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Delivery service is currently suspended due to staff shortages per the website. Private party hosting is available. Special order Japanese cakes and party trays are offered.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegan ramen options explicitly listed (Vegan Original, Vegan Black, Vegan Tantan) with vegan toppings section; website states 'We have VEGAN RAMEN on our menu now' and references being among the first to serve vegan options. Tofu-based dishes appear throughout the menu
